The '''''Sweet Victory''''' was a [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] that was captured by [[Zan Dane]]. He used it as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] for his [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] fleet.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
